key_findings: Intrathecal melatonin dose-dependently reversed paclitaxel-induced allodynia/hyperalgesia via MT2 receptors, blocked by the MT2 antagonist 4P-PDOT.

Melatonin reversed the PTX-induced pNEK2-dependent epigenetic program (pRSK2, pNEK2, JMJD3, H3K27me3, TRPV1) in DRG neurons, with repeated dosing during PTX more effective than a single post-treatment dose.
